g.card: Kyusa swiici n’olungamya buli kagaali k’omu mwala okutuuka ku mulyango gwa langi yaako.
g.genre: Omuzannyo gwa puzzle ogw’oluguudo lw’eggaali n’obugaali
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: puzzle 90 ez’oluguudo lw’eggaali mu mpuku 6 eza kristalo. Kyusa swiici n’olungamya buli kagaali okutuuka ku mulyango gwa langi yaako.
g.h2: Puzzle y’oluguudo lw’eggaali mu mpuku za gnome
g.p1: Obugaali buva mu kkubo ery’omu ttaka ne butambula bwokka. Kyusa swiici buli kamu katuuke ku mulyango gwa langi yaako nga tekatomeraganye.
g.p2: Emitendera 90 mu mpuku 6: emikono, ebibanda ebikyuka, omuzira, amazzi agalinnya ne lava. Funa emmunyeenye 3 n’entambula ntono, era gnome akuyamba bw’olemererwa.
l.card: Kyusa endabirwamu, lungamya ebimuli by’omusana era ozzeemu okwakisa ebisenge 150 eby’olubiri.
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: kyusa endabirwamu olungamye ekitangaala eri kristalo mu mitendera 150 ne mu nsi 6 ezaasiigibwa.
l.h2: Puzzle y’ekitangaala mu lubiri olw’amagezi ag’ekyama
l.p1: Olubiri luzikidde. Kyusa endabirwamu n’ebisenge olungamye ebimuli eri kristalo: bwe zonna zaaka, oluggi olwa zaabu luggulwawo.
l.p2: Emitendera 150 mu nsi 6: langi ez’okutabula, endabirwamu eza langi, purizimu, ebifaananyi n’ebinnyo. Obuyambi, n’emmunyeenye 3 ku buli mutendera eri abagezi.
l.f2: Endabirwamu, purizimu, endabirwamu eza langi n’ebinnyo
d.card: Dduka, buuka mu bbanga era ofuuwe omuliro mu bwakabaka 7 obw’amagezi ag’ekyama n’abakulu baabwo 7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: omuzannyo gwa pulatifoomu ogwa 2D ogwasiigibwa n’omukono. Yita mu bwakabaka 7, emitendera 63 n’abakulu 7 ogobe Kabaka w’Ebisiikirize.
d.p1: Zannya nga ogusota omuto omubisi ogw’obuvumu. Dduka, buuka, seeyeeya mu bbanga era ofuuwe omuliro ogobe Kabaka w’Ebisiikirize.
d.p2: Obwakabaka 7, emitendera 63 n’abakulu 7, buli omu n’akakodyo ke. Kuŋŋaanya kristalo era ofune emmunyeenye okutuuka ku 3 ku buli mutendera.
d.f2: Abakulu 7 b’olina okuwangula, buli omu n’akakodyo ke
t.card: Sala, kyusa era oteeke ebire okuggulira omutunzi omuto ekkubo.
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: puzzle 240 mu bitundu 12 eby’eggulu. Sala, kyusa era oteeke ebire okuggulawo ekkubo.
t.h2: Omuzannyo gwa puzzle ogw’emirembe mu ggulu
t.p1: Ebizinga biseeyeeya mu ggulu era oluggi olw’amagezi ag’ekyama lulindiridde. Sala ebire, bikyuse era obiteeke ozimbe ekkubo ly’omutunzi omuto.
t.p2: Emitendera 240 mu bitundu 12 ebyasiigibwa, awatali ssaawa. Funa emmunyeenye 3, ggulawo ebisanduuko era okuŋŋaanye ebire.
w.card: Teeka ebinnyo, twala amaanyi era ozuukize obwakabaka obwebase.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: puzzle 150 ez’ebyuma mu nsi 6 ez’engero. Teeka ebinnyo era otwale amaanyi okuddamu okutambuza ebyuma.
w.h2: Omuzannyo gwa puzzle ogw’ebinnyo ebya ddala
w.p1: Ekikolimo kyakwasizza obwakabaka. Teeka ebinnyo mu kifo ekituufu otwale amaanyi ga yingini ey’amagezi ag’ekyama era oddemu okutambuza ebyuma.
w.p2: Emitendera 150 mu nsi 6: runa, emikono, ebimuli bya kristalo n’essaawa y’omusenyu. Funa emmunyeenye 3 era olabe maapu nga zizzeemu langi zaazo.
u.card: Teeka obubulooka bwa runa obugwa era okuŋŋaanye runa za langi emu zibulewo.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: teeka obubulooka bwa runa obugwa, kuŋŋaanya langi era ogatte combo mu mitendera 180 ne mu bitundu 6.
u.p1: Obubulooka bwa runa bugwa ku lubaawo. Bitambuze era obikyuse okuŋŋaanya runa za langi emu: zibulawo era buli kimu ne kigwa wansi.
u.p2: Emitendera 180 mu bitundu 6, okuva ku Munaala gw’Omulogo okutuuka ku Kigo ky’Eggulu. Gatta combo ofune emmunyeenye 3.
n.card: Lungamya ogusota, lya runa era okule nga tolumye mukira gwo.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: omuzannyo gw’omusota ogulimu ogusota ogw’omuliro. Lya runa, weewale ebiziyiza era owangule abakuumi 6 mu mitendera 120.
n.p1: Ogusota tegulekera awo kutambula. Seetula engalo okugukyusa, lya runa okukula era weewale bisenge n’omubiri gwo.
n.p2: Emitendera 120 mu bitundu 6, buli kimu kikuumibwa omukulu. Runa ez’amagezi ag’ekyama zikendeeza obudde, zikufuula omuzimu oba zikukuuma.
